wars.name: Operation Chahar
wars.outcome: Japanese victory: Kalgan fell on 27 August 1937 and Xuanhua was reached by 7 September; the operation ended on 17 October 1937.

notes:
Written by ea-08-x on 2026-10-24 from five pages (the 'Actions in Inner Mongolia (1933-36)' page and 'Chin-Doihara Agreement' did not load: url_not_found at the site). No Cliopatria row exists for Mengjiang. Settled: the sequence northern Chahar (May 1936), eastern Suiyuan (1937), Kalgan and Datong (1 September 1939) and the end (19 August 1945). The 24 March 1940 nominal incorporation into the Reorganized National Government (Wang Jingwei regime) is a vassal_start in that dossier (counterpart mengjiang) rather than here, because this dossier records land.

Not settled: (1) the founding month, 12 May 1936 (Mengjiang page) against 'February 1936' (Suiyuan campaign page); (2) which towns and leagues made up 'northern Chahar' and 'eastern Suiyuan': rings stand in; the Republic of China and Empire of Japan dossiers (ea-08-c, jk-01-d) draw the whole of Cliopatria's Empire of Japan 1936-1938 growth in Inner Mongolia from 1936, which is larger than this dossier's 1936 shape; (3) Chahar occupation of 1933-1935 (Chin-Doihara Agreement, the six northern counties) is not dated on any page opened; (4) the South Chahar (founded 4 September 1937 at Kalgan per the Operation Chahar page) and North Shanxi Autonomous Governments were separate puppet governments until 1 September 1939; they have no dossier of their own (below the ten-year bar) and appear as counterparts by name; (5) Mongol capital before 1939 not dated; (6) Suiyuan was not entirely taken: the Ordos and the Hetao west of Baotou stayed Chinese in the pages' silence; (7) Kalgan went to the Soviet-Mongolian group, the other lands to whoever held them in August 1945, which the pages do not say. Gazetteer names needed: 'Dolon Nur' (a place, Duolun in Xilingol), 'Chahar', 'Suiyuan' (regions).

[ea-08-x repair 2026-10-25, after the adversarial review (verdict fail)] (1) Added the missing vassal events, from the vassal's side as in the kumul-khanate dossier: vassal_start/vassal_end empire-of-japan (northern Chahar 1936-5, eastern Suiyuan 1937, South Chahar and North Shanxi 1939-9, each ended 1945-8; mirrors empire-of-japan /ledger/45 and /87) and vassal_start 1940-3 / vassal_end 1945-8 reorganized-national-government-of-china (mirrors reorganized-national-government-of-china /ledger/2 and /6; the infobox gives 24 March 1940 and the page calls the incorporation nominal). I changed my earlier position that the 1940 relation belonged only in the other dossier: both sides record vassal events. The relation to Japan and to the RNG runs in parallel; the page gives no ranking. (2) The North Shanxi gain stays at confidence 2 (done in the first review round: Datong is not on the page). (3) The Zhangbei capital strip for 1936-1938 is marked a reading in its name and note; the page names no earlier seat and the Zhangbei sentence belongs to the 1939-1941 paragraph. (4) Added the rename of 4 August 1941 (Mongolian Autonomous State, on the Mengjiang page). (5) Not settled, and the page the review suggested does not settle it: which part of Suiyuan fell in 1937 and when. The Battle of Taiyuan page (opened) says only that the battle gave Japan 'part of Suiyuan, most of Shanxi' (1 September - 9 November 1937) and does not mention Baotou, Guisui or Mengjiang; the eastern-Suiyuan ring stays a reading at confidence 2.
